Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JMI Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at Jamia Millia Islamia is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E/M.Tech degree with a First Division, specializing in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Design, or CAD/CAM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 33,500/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this JMI recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the email is sent before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. Please refer to the official notification for more details on the contract duration.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The link to download the official notification PDF can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position announced by Jamia Millia Islamia.
